note: [N] nasqret/z-in-q-lean, no counterpart; Sun28.AuxiliaryPrimes.prime_with_symbols proved: The multi-vertex realization with types and mutual bits by distinct fresh primes is not stated. The closest lemma, Sun28.AuxiliaryPrimes.prime_with_symbols, gives one large prime in a class mod 12 with prescribed Jacobi symbols against primes > 3, for Sun's construction.

snippet.text:
theorem prime_with_symbols (S : Finset ℕ) (hs : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime ∧ 3<p)
    (bits : ℕ → Bool) {r : ℕ} (hr : r.Coprime 12) (bound : ℕ) :
    ∃ q > bound, q.Prime ∧ q ≡ r [MOD 12] ∧
      ∀ p ∈ S, jacobiSym q p = (if bits p then -1 else 1) := by
